en.title: Tired Flyers visit a Capitals team that has been rested
en.deck: Philadelphia lost 4-3 in overtime to Columbus on Tuesday after scoring the tying goal with about ten seconds left, and now plays the second night of a back-to-back. Washington ends a five-game homestand at 5-2-0 at home and has played once in seven days. The market makes the Capitals clear favourites; the model sees a closer game.
news: Logan Thompson took a full practice on Tuesday, and the NHL status report lists him as probable to return. Spencer Carbery said he would check with the trainers before deciding, so Charlie Lindgren could start again.
Joseph Woll is the likely Flyers starter because Dan Vladar played on Tuesday. Woll is 1-4-2 with a .904 save percentage.

Cam York returned on Tuesday after missing eight games. Rasmus Ristolainen is out for at least two weeks after he re-injured himself in his first game back. Travis Konecny and Owen Tippett are on injured reserve.
Jakob Chychrun took a maintenance day on Monday and is expected to play. The Capitals play in Nashville on Thursday.
records: The Flyers are 0-4 in games that go past regulation. Rick Tocchet called their overtime decisions "mind boggling" after Tuesday's loss.
Philadelphia scores 1.85 goals a game and shoots 8.1%, both last in the NHL. Only 4 of its 14 games have gone over 5.5 goals, against 8 of Washington's 10.
Matvei Michkov scored his 50th NHL goal on Oct. 17 in his 171st game, and he has 8 goals this season. Trevor Zegras has a five-game point streak with 3 goals and 6 assists.
Alex Tuch has 7 goals in 10 games for Washington. He scored the overtime winner against his old team, Buffalo, on Saturday.

sv.title: Trötta Flyers möter ett utvilat Capitals
sv.deck: Philadelphia kvitterade med cirka tio sekunder kvar men föll med 4-3 efter förlängning mot Columbus i tisdags, och spelar nu andra kvällen i rad. Washington avslutar en hemmaserie på fem matcher, har 5-2-0 hemma och har bara spelat en match på sju dagar. Marknaden har Capitals som klara favoriter, medan modellen ser en jämnare match.
news: Logan Thompson tränade fullt i tisdags och står som trolig att återvända i NHL:s skaderapport. Spencer Carbery ville prata med de medicinska ledarna först, så Charlie Lindgren kan få starta igen.
Joseph Woll väntas stå för Flyers eftersom Dan Vladar spelade i tisdags. Woll har 1-4-2 och 90,4 % räddningar.

Jakob Chychrun vilade på måndagen men väntas spela. Capitals spelar i Nashville på torsdag.

en.title: McDavid brings a record-tying assist streak to the first Battle of Alberta
en.deck: Connor McDavid has an assist in all 12 Oilers games this season, which ties the NHL record for a season start. Edmonton has lost two straight at home and is now without Zach Hyman, while Calgary, which opened with five regulation losses, has won four in a row. The market makes the Oilers big favourites; the model is noticeably warmer on the Flames.
news: Zach Hyman is in concussion protocol after he was hit into the glass on Monday, and Jason Gregor reports he is likely out at least a week. Mattias Ekholm returns from his own concussion, per the NHL status report.
Jason Dickinson could return after missing six games; the medical staff decides on Wednesday morning.
Tristan Jarry is the only healthy regular in the Edmonton net, with Frederik Andersen out until late November or December and Devin Levi on injured reserve. Jarry has an .862 save percentage.
Devin Cooley has started and won Calgary's last four games and is the likely starter again. Mikael Backlund returned on Monday and scored; Jonathan Huberdeau is still not close to playing.
records: McDavid has 8 goals and 26 assists. Only Wayne Gretzky, Ken Linseman and Sebastian Aho have also started a season with assists in 12 straight games.
Leon Draisaitl has 12 goals and 24 points. Through 11 games McDavid had a point on 33 of Edmonton's 48 goals.
Backlund's goal on Monday was his 609th point, tying Johnny Gaudreau for fifth in Flames history. Matvei Gridin had his first three-point game in the same win over Toronto.
Edmonton's power play scores 35.0% of the time, but its penalty kill (70.6%) ranks 25th. Nine of the Oilers' 12 games have gone over 5.5 goals.

sv.title: McDavid tar med sig en rekordsvit i assist till säsongens första Battle of Alberta
sv.deck: Connor McDavid har assist i alla Oilers tolv matcher i år, vilket tangerar NHL-rekordet för en säsongsinledning. Edmonton har förlorat två raka hemma och saknar nu Zach Hyman, medan Calgary, som inledde med fem förluster efter full tid, har vunnit fyra raka. Marknaden har Oilers som stora favoriter, men modellen tror klart mer på Flames.
news: Zach Hyman genomgår hjärnskakningsprotokollet efter en tackling mot sargen i måndags, och enligt Jason Gregor är han troligen borta minst en vecka. Mattias Ekholm är tillbaka efter sin egen hjärnskakning, enligt NHL:s skaderapport.
Jason Dickinson kan göra comeback efter sex missade matcher; det avgörs på onsdagsmorgonen.
Tristan Jarry är den enda friska ordinarie målvakten i Edmonton, eftersom Frederik Andersen är borta till sent i november eller december och Devin Levi är skadad. Jarry räddar 86,2 %.
Devin Cooley har startat och vunnit Calgarys fyra senaste matcher och väntas starta igen. Mikael Backlund var tillbaka i måndags och gjorde mål; Jonathan Huberdeau är fortfarande långt ifrån spel.

en.title: Red-hot Devils turn to Allen in Denver after Hellebuyck's debut
en.deck: New Jersey has won four straight and six of seven, finishing with a 5-1 win in Dallas on Tuesday in Connor Hellebuyck's first game since the trade. Jake Allen gets the second night of the back-to-back against an Avalanche team that has lost three of four. The market and the model both favour Colorado by about the same margin.
news: The Devils acquired Hellebuyck from Winnipeg on Oct. 23, sending Dawson Mercer and others the other way. He stopped 16 of 17 shots in Dallas, and The Athletic reports that Allen starts tonight.
Colorado has not named a starter. Mackenzie Blackwood won on Thursday and Scott Wedgewood lost 6-2 in Nashville on Saturday.
Nicolas Roy was a full participant in practice on Tuesday and could return after missing six games. Nazem Kadri moved to the third-line centre spot.
Jared Bednar called the Nashville performance "the exact opposite" of what his team needs. Seamus Casey (knee) is still out for the Devils.
records: The Devils beat Colorado 4-3 in New Jersey on Oct. 20. Allen earned his 229th career win in his 500th game that night, and he is 12-8-3 against the Avalanche.
Artturi Lehkonen leads Colorado with 10 goals and has a seven-game point streak (7 goals, 3 assists).
Nathan MacKinnon has 21 points. His four-point game on Oct. 23 was his 45th career three-assist game, tying Joe Sakic for third in franchise history.
Colorado scores 4.08 goals a game, second in the NHL. New Jersey leads the league with 34.1 shots a game, and Nico Hischier has 7 goals, two of them on Tuesday.

en.title: Matthews arrives in Seattle fresh off 800 points
en.deck: Auston Matthews reached 800 points in Calgary on Monday in his 703rd game, the fastest in Maple Leafs history, but Toronto lost 5-2 and saw its four-game winning streak end. Seattle has lost Jared McCann for about ten weeks and was outshot 16-1 in one period of a 5-1 loss to Minnesota. Market and model both see a coin flip.
news: Kirill Marchenko left Monday's game with a lower-body injury and is day-to-day. Jim Hiller said it is "never a good sign" that he could not return. Marchenko came from Columbus in the September trade for Matthew Knies.
John Tavares is skating but has no return date, and Chris Tanev skated in a non-contact jersey. Max Domi is also still out.
Philipp Grubauer (4-1-1, .907) is projected for Seattle. Toronto has not confirmed its goalie: Sergei Bobrovsky played on Monday, Anthony Stolarz on Saturday.
McCann is out about ten weeks with a lower-body injury, and Ryan Lindgren and Jacob Melanson are also out. Lane Lambert called losing McCann "a blow to us for sure."
records: Matthews needed 703 games for 800 points; Darryl Sittler needed 742. He and William Nylander both have 9 goals, and Nylander scored his 300th NHL goal on Saturday.
Ten of Seattle's 12 games have gone over 5.5 goals. The Kraken blew multi-goal third-period leads in two straight games last week.
This is the third stop of a four-game western trip for Toronto, which is 3-1-1 on the road this season.
Kaapo Kakko leads Seattle with 10 points. The model flags Darren Raddysh as due: he has no goals in 14 games despite his chances.
betting: Market: Leafs 1.89, Kraken 1.95, about 51–49 to Toronto without the margin. The model has an even 50–50.

sv.title: Matthews kommer till Seattle med 800 poäng i ryggen
sv.deck: Auston Matthews nådde 800 poäng i Calgary i måndags i sin 703:e match, snabbast i Maple Leafs historia, men Toronto förlorade med 5-2 och såg sin svit på fyra raka segrar ta slut. Seattle har förlorat Jared McCann i ungefär tio veckor och blev utskjutet med 16-1 i en period i 5-1-förlusten mot Minnesota. Både marknaden och modellen ser en slantsingling.
news: Kirill Marchenko lämnade måndagens match med en skada i underkroppen och är dag-till-dag. Jim Hiller sa att det aldrig är ett gott tecken när en spelare inte kan komma tillbaka. Marchenko kom från Columbus i septemberbytet mot Matthew Knies.
John Tavares åker skridskor men har inget datum för comeback, och Chris Tanev tränade i en tröja för spel utan kroppskontakt. Max Domi är också fortsatt borta.
Philipp Grubauer (4-1-1, 90,7 %) väntas stå för Seattle. Toronto har inte bekräftat sin målvakt: Sergei Bobrovsky spelade i måndags, Anthony Stolarz i lördags.
McCann är borta i cirka tio veckor med en skada i underkroppen, och även Ryan Lindgren och Jacob Melanson saknas. Lane Lambert kallade förlusten av McCann ett hårt slag.

Tio av Seattles tolv matcher har gått över 5,5 mål. Kraken tappade ledningar med flera mål i tredje perioden två matcher i rad förra veckan.
Det här är tredje matchen på en västturné med fyra matcher för Toronto, som har 3-1-1 på bortaplan i år.
